name: fle_tools
title: FLE Tools (spectator-safe runtime)
author: fle
description: Bundles the Factorio Learning Environment agent/admin tool functions and event handlers into a mod loaded identically by the server and all clients, so a spectator client can join the live game in lockstep. Functions live in _G (fle_actions/fle_utils) and are exposed via the 'fle' remote interface; storage holds only serializable data. Pair with FLE_USE_MOD=1 on the Python side.
